blocks.text: The module documentation defines the D3 edit shape, matching order, ambiguity rule, CRLF behavior, and scope-warning semantics. Constants and regexes bound matching and support helpful failure messages.
blocks.title: Edit pipeline contract

blocks.text: The dataclasses carry match locations, failures, proposed file content, net operations, and referenced ranges. ApplyResult exposes success and the downstream edit-file shape.
blocks.title: Result and scope types

blocks.text: Helpers convert text to LF views, map normalized offsets back to original text, choose the dominant file ending, and trim search blocks for line matching.
blocks.title: Line-ending normalization

blocks.anchor: def find_matches(text: str, search: str) -> list[Match]:
blocks.text: find_matches returns all exact hits first; only when none exist does it compare whole lines after collapsing whitespace. Failure text identifies gutters and nearby lines for model retries.
blocks.title: Exact and whitespace matching

blocks.text: The tracker narrows ambiguous candidates toward selected ranges, checks whether an edit overlaps the referenced scope, and shifts ranges when earlier edits change line counts.
blocks.title: Selection-aware matching

blocks.text: Replacement helpers infer a uniform indentation delta, choose a unique match or raise a precise edit problem, and splice exact or whitespace-matched text while preserving the file's line-ending style.
blocks.title: Applying one replacement

blocks.text: Diff statistics count added and removed lines using difflib, failures are formatted for retry prompts, and path cleanup removes leading ./ segments.
blocks.title: Diff and path helpers

blocks.text: The entry point validates each edit, maintains per-path state, applies create/replace/delete operations in order, collects failures, and emits only changed, size-allowed FileResult values.
blocks.title: Ordered edit application

gotchas: The module never reads or writes files.
A failed edit causes later edits for that path to be reported as skipped.
Scope violations are reported for review but do not prevent an edit from being applied.

purpose: This module turns structured replace/create/delete proposals into per-file proposed text and review metadata. It handles exact and whitespace-normalized matching, line-ending preservation, scope warnings, ordered multi-edit state, and actionable failures; callers provide file contents and path validation.
summary: Deterministically matches and applies model-proposed code edits without performing I/O.
